title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. translated_title: SWE-Duel：迈向面向编程智能体的自扩展竞技场
translated_abstract: 静态编程基准在发布之时便已固定。随着时间推移，其任务内容会泄露到训练数据中，更强的智能体最终会使这些基准饱和。我们认为，基准测试应当追求“自扩展”：其任务与判定标准在评估时才被创建，因此不存在预先可供泄露的内容，且其难度由参与的智能体决定，而非在发布时固定。我们提出了 SWE-Duel，一个让两个编程智能体通过镜像的红蓝对抗回合相互评估的竞技场。在每一回合中，红方智能体在一个真实代码仓库上通过三个上下文隔离的会话进行操作：它提出并实现一个带有特性测试的新功能，然后在该功能中植入一个隐蔽的缺陷，并附带密封的缺陷触发测试。所产生的拉取请求只有在满足以下条件时才会被接受：(1) 它通过特性测试和仓库的现有测试，同时恰好只在缺陷测试上失败；(2) 同一智能体的全新会话能够在“盲修”条件下修复该缺陷……
tldr: SWE-Duel 提出了一种自扩展的编程智能体评估竞技场：两个智能体以红蓝对抗的方式互相出题——红方在真实仓库中实现新功能并植入隐蔽缺陷，蓝方进行盲修——使任务在评估时动态生成、无内容可泄露，且难度随参与智能体的能力提升而自动扩展。
en_tdlr: SWE-Duel introduces a self-scaling arena where two coding agents duel over mirrored Red-Blue turns—creating new features with hidden bugs for each other to blindly repair—so that tasks are generated at evaluation time with nothing to leak and difficulty scales with the participating agents themselves.
